findings.evidence: Constraint `regression-test-present` says behavior changes require full integration coverage at the lowest public boundary; this diff changes `SurrealQueryEngine::query_natural` routing in `crates/compass-query/src/surreal.rs` and owner-level Surreal relationship enrichment in `crates/compass-query/src/code_query.rs`, but the packet diff contains only those two production files and no `tests` or integration fixture updates.
